jobs.description: Sr Mobile - Developer Bajaj Capital Ltd Gurugram, Haryana, India 21 hours ago Over 200 applicants See who Bajaj Capital Ltd has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job Direct message the job poster from Bajaj Capital Ltd Gaurav S. Gaurav S. Associate Vice President - Talent Acquisition BAJAJ CAPITAL LIMITED Job Description Senior Mobile Developer — React Native Gurgaon | Full-Time About Bajaj Capital Bajaj Capital is building the next generation of mobile-first financial products used by millions of investors across India. Our mobile engineering team delivers AI-augmented wealth management, investment, and insurance experiences on iOS and Android. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Mobile Developer with deep React Native expertise to lead feature development on our investor-facing and advisor-facing mobile applications. You will own critical mobile modules end-to-end — from architecture through App Store release — and actively integrate AI capabilities into the mobile experience. Key Responsibilities Design and develop high-quality, production-grade React Native features for iOS and Android apps serving retail investors and wealth advisors. Own module-level architecture decisions: navigation, state management, offline handling, performance optimisation, and security. Integrate with backend APIs for real-time portfolio data, transaction processing, KYC workflows (Digilocker, V-CIP, eSign), UPI, and payment flows. Implement AI-powered mobile features: intelligent recommendations, conversational interfaces, AI-assisted portfolio insights, and smart alerts. Write unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests; maintain high coverage on critical modules. Conduct thorough code reviews; mentor junior and mid-level mobile engineers. Optimise app performance: startup time, frame rates, memory profiling, and battery usage. Manage app release pipelines: CI/CD, TestFlight/Play Console beta, App Store/Play Store deployment, and OTA updates. Collaborate with Product, Design (Figma), and Backend teams in Agile sprints. Required Qualifications 4–8 years of mobile development experience with 3+ years in production React Native apps. Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals; deep understanding of React hooks, context, and performance patterns. Experience with state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or Jotai) and navigation (React Navigation v6+). Hands-on with native modules/bridging when React Native abstractions are insufficient. Experience with mobile CI/CD (Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, or equivalent). Knowledge of mobile app security: certificate pinning, biometric auth, secure storage, jailbreak/root detection. B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed institution. Good to Have Experience in fintech or BFSI mobile apps — MF transaction apps, trading apps, insurance apps, or payment apps. Familiarity with SEBI/AMFI/IRDAI compliance requirements for digital financial products. Exposure to LLM integration on mobile: streaming responses or AI assistant UX patterns. Experience with React Native New Architecture (Fabric, JSI, TurboModules). AI Expectations Use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) as standard daily practice. Actively propose and prototype AI-powered mobile features: smart search, chatbots, personalised nudges, intelligent onboarding. Drive AI adoption within the mobile team through AI-assisted tests, documentation, and code review. Save Report this job About Siemens Healthineers At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our purpose is to empower healthcare providers with innovative, reliable, and intelligent technologies that improve patient outcomes and make healthcare more accessible. By combining advanced medical devices, intelligent software, and modern engineering practices, we build solutions that address real-world healthcare challenges while ensuring sustainability and long-term impact. As AI transforms the way software is engineered and experienced, we are looking for AI-Native Software Developers who can leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle while building secure, scalable, and intelligent healthcare applications. Role Overview As an AI-Native Software Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain high-quality software while effectively leveraging AI to accelerate engineering productivity and enhance software capabilities. You will integrate AI-powered services into applications, validate AI-generated outputs, and apply responsible AI principles to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable healthcare solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative products while continuously adopting emerging AI technologies and modern engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Analyze business and technical requirements and identify opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities where they add value. Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions using modern engineering practices. Leverage AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity while validating AI-generated code, tests, and documentation. Integrate AI-powered features, services, or intelligent agents into applications using enterprise AI platforms and context engineering principles. Ensure software quality, reliability, and performance through automated testing, continuous delivery, and validation of AI-enabled features. Apply secure coding and responsible AI practices to ensure privacy, compliance, and trustworthy AI solutions. Collaborate across global teams and continuously adopt emerging technologies to drive engineering excellence. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering/Information Technology, or related discipline. 4-7 years of experience in software development using modern engineering practices. Strong understanding of software architecture, object-oriented design, and design patterns. Experience developing enterprise-scale cloud-native applications. Technical Skills Software Engineering C# , .NET / .NET Core REST APIs, Microservices Angular / React / JavaScript / TypeScript /HTML5 / CSS Cloud & DevOps Microsoft Azure (preferred) Docker / Kubernetes Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines Infrastructure as Code (desirable) AI Engineering Experience integrating AI services or Large Language Models into applications. Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot or equivalent). Understanding of context engineering principles for enterprise AI applications. Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and AI orchestration frameworks is desirable. Familiarity with AI evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices. Software Quality Test automation TDD / BDD Secure coding Performance optimization Observability and monitoring Behavioral Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Growth mindset with passion for continuous learning. Ability to effectively collaborate across global teams. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to balance engineering excellence with rapid innovation. Ownership mindset and commitment to delivering customer value. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing healthcare software or regulated products. Familiarity with medical device software standards and secure software development practices. Exposure to AI agents, workflow automation, or enterprise AI platforms. Contributions to open-source projects or developer communities are an advantage.
